report.summary: The prior host-runner incompatibility is resolved. The launcher safely accepts only GIT_WORK_TREE resolving to its own repository while retaining sanitized Git subprocesses, with appropriate regression coverage. The committed environment seal and diagnostic reproduce their signed output-manifest digests; review, host-runner, and reference-runner records are consistently bound to trusted keys and the stated SHAs. The new diagnostic preserves the I3 failure and accurately leaves step 2 pending. Review was read-only and tests were not executed as instructed.
